# Code block

Snippet surface with an optional filename header and a copy-to-clipboard button.

Category: content · Behavior: js-inline · Schema: 1.0.0 · Source: original

## Variants

| `data-uifa-variant` | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `labeled` (default) | Header bar with a filename label and the copy button; omit data-uifa-variant. |
| `bare` | No header; the copy button floats top-right via `data-uifa-variant="bare"`. |

Reads: `--uifa-accent`, `--uifa-surface`, `--uifa-border`, `--uifa-border-strong`, `--uifa-border-width`, `--uifa-text`, `--uifa-text-muted`, `--uifa-radius-control`, `--uifa-font-body`, `--uifa-font-mono`, `--uifa-text-base`, `--uifa-space`, `--uifa-duration`, `--uifa-ease`. ## Markup

```html
<!-- Labeled variant (default): header bar with a filename label and copy button.
     Bare variant: data-uifa-variant="bare" with no header; the copy button floats top-right. -->
<div class="uifa-code-block">
  <div data-uifa-slot="header">
    <span data-uifa-slot="label">install.sh</span>
    <button type="button" data-uifa-slot="copy">Copy</button>
  </div>
  <pre data-uifa-slot="code"><code>node kit/scripts/uifa.mjs tokens
node kit/scripts/uifa.mjs add
node kit/validation/check.mjs</code></pre>
</div>
```

## Usage

Wrap a `<pre data-uifa-slot="code">` in `.uifa-code-block`; escape HTML entities in the snippet. The labeled variant (default) shows a `data-uifa-slot="label"` filename beside the copy button; `data-uifa-variant="bare"` drops the header and floats the button top-right. The script copies the snippet's text and flashes "Copied!" on the button.
